unsupported_claims: DeepWalk uses skip-gram to capture indirect, multi-hop co-occurrence relations that can reveal connections not directly observed (the evidence mentions truncated random walks and language-modeling ideas but not skip-gram or multi-hop mechanics explicitly)
rationale: The core claims match the evidence: DeepWalk is said to outperform baselines especially with missing information, and LINE models first-order proximity (observed ties) and second-order proximity (shared neighborhoods).
